requirements.text: A node has a description and and object, both of type string
An attribute has three attributes description and name (String), and key (boolean).
An XORGroup has one attribute : preliminary, which is a boolean.
An ORGRoup has an attribute that is a boolean and is called preliminary.
A node is composed of any number of attributes
A node may have/reference to one or many XORGroup
An attribute has a node. COmpulsory.
A child may have some nodes.
A child may have some ORGroup
AN XORGroup may have a node
AN ORGroup may have a node
